reason: The hypothesis directly restates the core finding of P1 and P2—that restricting atomic mobility during low-temperature reduction of a five-noble-metal precursor promotes stochastic nucleation and single-phase HEA formation, leading to enhanced ORR activity—as a prediction, and proposes the same intervention (dropwise, low-temperature injection) and comparison (versus high-temperature synthesis) that those passages already studied or suggested as future work. The mechanism is taken word for word from the stochastic model in P1 and P20. No new alloy, regime, or integrative mechanism beyond these sources is introduced.
